{"inp":{"code":"# Calculations for ELECTRO ACO ALTONA S.A. target price
patrimonio = 295589000.0
vpa = 13.137289
preco = 14.34
lpa = 2.957378
divida_liq = 108038000.0
ebit = 92788000.0
indenizacao = 17200000.0

# shares outstanding
shares = patrimonio / vpa
market_cap = preco * shares
ev = market_cap + divida_liq

# adjusted LPA
lpa_adj = lpa - (indenizacao / shares)

# Valuation methods
pe_multiple = 8.0
price_pe = lpa_adj * pe_multiple
price_pv = vpa * 1.0
# EV/EBIT method with multiple 5x conservative
ev_ebit_multiple = 5.0
ev_target = ebit * ev_ebit_multiple
marketcap_target_ev = ev_target - divida_liq
price_ev = marketcap_target_ev / shares

# Blend
price_blend = 0.4 * price_pe + 0.3 * price_pv + 0.3 * price_ev

shares, market_cap, ev, lpa_adj, price_pe, price_pv, price_ev, price_blend
print('shares', shares)
print('market_cap', market_cap)
print('ev', ev)
print('lpa_adj', lpa_adj)
print('price_pe', price_pe)
print('price_pv', price_pv)
print('price_ev', price_ev)
print('price_blend', price_blend)"} }
